title: Vocabulary: Clothes & Fashion
objective: Clothing, shopping for clothes and describing what people wear — common in PET descriptions and Reading.

items.meaning: to be the right size or shape for someone
items.example: These jeans fit me perfectly.
items.exampleZh: 这条牛仔裤我穿着非常合身。

items.meaning: to look attractive on someone
items.example: That colour really suits you.
items.exampleZh: 那个颜色真的很适合你。

items.meaning: one of the standard measures used for clothes or shoes
items.example: What size shoes do you take?
items.exampleZh: 你穿多大码的鞋？

items.meaning: to put on clothes to see if they fit
items.example: Can I try this jacket on?
items.exampleZh: 我可以试穿这件夹克吗？

items.meaning: to dress yourself in / remove clothing
items.example: Put on your coat and take off your wet shoes.
items.exampleZh: 穿上外套，把湿鞋脱掉。

items.meaning: to look good together or to have the same colour or pattern
items.example: Her shoes match her handbag perfectly.
items.exampleZh: 她的鞋子和手提包很相配。

items.meaning: the style of clothes that is popular at a particular time
items.example: Long skirts are back in fashion this year.
items.exampleZh: 今年长裙又流行起来了。

items.meaning: special clothes worn by members of a group or organisation
items.example: Students at my school wear a blue uniform.
items.exampleZh: 我们学校的学生穿蓝色校服。

items.meaning: comfortable shoes for sport or casual wear
items.example: I bought new trainers for the school race.
items.exampleZh: 我买了新运动鞋参加校运会赛跑。

items.meaning: trousers made of strong cotton cloth (denim)
items.example: He was wearing old jeans and a T-shirt.
items.exampleZh: 他穿着旧牛仔裤和T恤。

items.meaning: a long piece of clothing worn over other clothes in cold weather
items.example: Take your coat — it's freezing outside.
items.exampleZh: 带上你的大衣——外面很冷。

items.meaning: clothes worn on the hands to keep them warm
items.example: I can't find my gloves anywhere.
items.exampleZh: 我哪儿都找不到我的手套。

items.meaning: a piece of cloth worn around the neck for warmth
items.example: She wrapped a red scarf around her neck.
items.exampleZh: 她脖子上围着一条红围巾。

items.meaning: a long narrow piece of cloth worn under a shirt collar
items.example: Men at the office wear a suit and tie.
items.exampleZh: 办公室的男士穿西装、打领带。

items.meaning: pleasant to wear; not too tight or painful
items.example: These shoes are really comfortable for walking.
items.exampleZh: 这双鞋走路穿很舒服。

items.meaning: fitting very closely / not fitting closely
items.example: The shirt is a bit tight, but the trousers are too loose.
items.exampleZh: 衬衫有点紧，但裤子太宽松了。

items.meaning: a design of shapes or colours on cloth
items.example: I like the striped pattern on that dress.
items.exampleZh: 我喜欢那条裙子上的条纹图案。

items.meaning: materials clothes are made from: soft plant cloth, animal skin, sheep's hair
items.example: A cotton T-shirt is cooler than a woollen jumper.
items.exampleZh: 棉T恤比羊毛衫凉快。

items.meaning: informal and relaxed, not formal
items.example: It's a casual party, so jeans are fine.
items.exampleZh: 这是个休闲聚会，穿牛仔裤就行。

items.meaning: to become thin or damaged from too much use
items.example: He wore out the soles of his shoes quickly.
items.exampleZh: 他很快就把鞋底磨坏了。

keyPoints: Use fit and suit differently: fit is about size, suit is about looking good.
Describe an outfit with colour, material and pattern, then say when you wear it.
Remember clothing words are often countable pairs: gloves, jeans, trainers, trousers.
